items.system: Public HTTPS hosting + App Store Connect metadata
items.action: Host site/ over HTTPS and expose the support page. APP_STORE_BASE_URL can generate /support automatically, or APP_STORE_SUPPORT_URL can point to a custom production HTTPS URL.
items.evidence: The support URL opens without auth, redirects, localhost, .test, .local, or example domains, and docs/public-site-hosting-verification.md reports a live PASS.
items.label: Public support URL

items.system: Public HTTPS hosting + App Store Connect metadata
items.action: Host site/ over HTTPS and expose the privacy policy page. APP_STORE_BASE_URL can generate /privacy automatically, or APP_STORE_PRIVACY_URL can point to a custom production HTTPS URL.
items.evidence: The privacy URL opens without auth, matches docs/app-store-privacy-answers.md plus the final AdMob state, and docs/public-site-hosting-verification.md reports a live PASS.
items.label: Public privacy URL

items.system: Public HTTPS hosting + App Store Connect metadata
items.action: Optional. Set APP_STORE_MARKETING_URL or APP_STORE_BASE_URL if the App Store listing should include a marketing URL.
items.evidence: A production HTTPS marketing URL is available, or this optional field is intentionally left blank.
items.label: Public marketing URL

items.action: Add the review contact that Apple can use during App Review. Use a monitored email address and a reachable phone number.
items.evidence: store.config.js resolves apple.review, metadata preview shows reviewContactReady=true, and release:status reports the contact OK.
items.label: App Store review contact

items.action: Optional for a NO_LIVE_ADS launch. Before monetization, create production AdMob apps and rewarded ad units, then put all four real IDs into .env.local and the EAS production environment.
items.evidence: A no-ID build stays in NO_LIVE_ADS state. A monetized build uses four production-format IDs and app.config.js enables liveAdsEnabled.
items.label: Live AdMob IDs
items.detail: Optional for the NO_LIVE_ADS launch; rewarded ads stay disabled until all four production IDs are set.

items.action: Confirm app.json ios.bundleIdentifier and android.package are the final store identifiers before the first production build.
items.evidence: The identifiers in app.json match Apple Developer, App Store Connect, Google Play/AdMob records, and EAS project settings.
items.label: APP_STORE_BUNDLE_ID_CONFIRMED
items.detail: Set to 1 only after the real external action is complete.

items.action: Create the App Store Connect app record for the final bundle ID and fill the app category, age rating, pricing, availability, and required compliance fields.
items.evidence: The App Store Connect record exists for com.john.kanasprint, and metadata can be pushed with EAS Metadata after release:store-ready passes.
items.label: APP_STORE_CONNECT_RECORD_READY
items.detail: Set to 1 only after the real external action is complete.

items.action: Log in to Expo and run npx eas-cli build:version:set once for the production iOS app because eas.json uses remote app version management.
items.evidence: EAS remote version state exists for the production profile and app.json buildNumber no longer needs local manual increments.
items.label: EAS_REMOTE_VERSION_INITIALIZED

items.action: Fill App Store Connect privacy answers from docs/app-store-privacy-answers.md after deciding whether live AdMob IDs are enabled for the submitted build.
items.evidence: The App Store privacy questionnaire matches the final build, optional rewarded ads, local-only progress storage, and iOS privacy manifest.
items.label: APP_STORE_PRIVACY_ANSWERS_REVIEWED
items.detail: Set to 1 only after the real external action is complete.

items.action: Required only for a LIVE_ADMOB build. Configure AdMob Privacy & messaging for release regions and verify UMP canRequestAds before requesting rewarded ads.
items.evidence: NO_LIVE_ADS builds do not request ads. A monetized production/TestFlight build confirms privacy options and rewarded ads behave correctly with the real AdMob account.
verification: physical iPhone or TestFlight ad-flow test
items.label: ADMOB_PRIVACY_MESSAGES_CONFIGURED
items.detail: Not required for the NO_LIVE_ADS launch; required before enabling production AdMob.

items.action: Install the production archive or TestFlight build on a real iPhone and complete docs/production-device-smoke-test.md for first launch, language selection, N5-N1 game loop, settings, support/privacy/open-source links, BGM, and rewarded-ad continue path.
items.evidence: The exact production build that will be submitted has passed the manual smoke path on device.
items.label: PRODUCTION_DEVICE_TESTED
items.detail: Set to 1 only after the real external action is complete.
